# Where support teams turn conversations into resolutionsintelligencerenewalssignalsword-of-mouthretention

Go from just-keeping-up to service that drives growth. In Help Scout, teams work alongside AI to not only resolve conversations faster, but understand the larger story they’re telling.

## Most AI support platforms force teams to compromise on service.With Help Scout, even the highest standards scale.

### Replies hit the mark

Our AI agent, Scout, resolves 73% of the requests it receives on average.

### Handoffs carry context

Teams respond to 56% more messages in their first year with nothing lost across escalations.

### Trends surface early

Proactive monitoring lets you act while there’s still time to get ahead of issues, so customers (and leadership) stay happy.

## Empowering best-in-class experiences for your customer base through four key products:
[Inbox](https://helpscout.com/inbox/), [Envoy](https://helpscout.com/agent/), [Copilot](https://helpscout.com/copilot/), and [Signal](https://helpscout.com/signal/).

## Inbox never loses the thread

Working across teams and channels doesn’t have to be messy. Inbox brings email, SMS, social, chat, and voice into one clean space. Assignments happen automatically. Context carries through every handoff. And workflows keep it all organized.

[Explore Inbox](https://helpscout.com/inbox/)

![Home-Sep2026-Inbox](https://hs-marketing-contentful.imgix.net/https%3A%2F%2Fimages.ctfassets.net%2Fp15sglj92v6o%2F1WaLtujJumkDyVWJZAdZWS%2F16938b0bb981277f05aae2974570116c%2Fhs-home-product-inbox.png?ixlib=gatsbySourceUrl-2.1.3&auto=format%2C%20compress&q=75&w=365&h=570&s=2cf9ccee425515457bff3425b60fed50)

## AI built for the right response, not just the fastest

Envoy combines frontier models with insights learned from 3+ billion conversations. The result? Your own powerful AI agent, Scout, that delivers accurate answers, smooth escalations, and judgment that reflects your own.

## Move faster with the team you have

Copilot speeds up the extra Inbox work that drags response time down. Generate drafts instead of checking past replies. Ask questions instead of searching your knowledge base. Get triage suggestions. It’s the assistant that makes everything easier.

[Explore Copilot](https://helpscout.com/copilot/)

## Catch friction before it becomes a fire

Closing out conversations is just the beginning. Signal shows you the story behind them, so you can get ahead of emerging issues, save drifting accounts, and see what basic reporting misses.

[Explore Signal](https://helpscout.com/signal/)

## 15 years ago

Help Scout started with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, that belief is more important than it’s ever been. But now it takes something different.

AI has to solve customer problems faster *and* better. The customer relationship has to stay in view across channels, contacts, and handoffs. And insights have to show you what’s coming next, not just what already happened. Getting those right adds up to [results](https://helpscout.com/customers/) the whole business can feel.

If that’s how you're looking to grow, try Help Scout free. We’d love to see where it takes you.
